channel.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu
channel.description: National news and headlines from within or around India with live updates on major breaking events from The Hindu.

image.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu

item.title: Cyclone Arnab to weaken into depression on October 29, says IMD | LIVE updates
item.description: At least 17 districts of southern Odisha affected by heavy rainfall due to cyclonic storm Arnab; Andhra Pradesh records five deaths as CM Naidu announces relief measures

item.title: Cyclone ‘Arnab’ highlights | Five killed in Andhra; Telangana extends support to Andhra for restoration works
item.description: The storm now heads for Odisha, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand and West Bengal, where heavy rain is forecast

item.title: Karnataka SIR: 64.5 lakh voters potentially missing in rolls, majority of them young
item.description: Elector-to-population ratio released officially by Karnataka CEO shows under-enrolment of about 64.5 lakh electors, of whom roughly 38.41 lakh are in the 18 to 29 age group.

item.title: In setback to BJP, Congress wins Nagpur MLC seat
item.description: The Congress fielded sitting MLC Abhijeet Wanjari, who secured 67,231 votes, while the BJP fielded former MLA Sudhakar Kohale, who secured 63,960 votes

item.title: Modi will return to Red Fort as PM in 2029, Congress breathing its last under Rahul: Nitin Nabin
item.description: “Congress leaders are distressed by the SIR exercise that seeks to clean up the voter list, but the BJP is committed to ensuring that infiltrators are removed from it,” says Nabin

item.title: Cabinet approves 3% hike in dearness allowance for central government employees
item.description: The DA and DR increase will be effective from July 1, 2026 and will benefit 48.54 lakh employees and 68.71 lakh pensioners

item.title: Digital Personal Data Protection Act does not infringe on press freedom: Ashwini Vaishnaw
item.description: IT Minister invites editors and media professionals to engage in open dialogue with government to discuss concerns surrounding the law

item.title: ED attaches land, buildings of Mohammad Ali Jauhar University in Rampur in money laundering case
item.description: “ED found that funds meant for public works were diverted to the University, government works were executed on its private campus, and funds from contractors who had been allotted government contracts were routed back to the Trust as donations,” the statement said

item.title: Poland pivots towards India as ‘strategic partnership’ with China develops cracks
item.description: Poland and India seek to raise bilateral trade from $6 bn to $10 bn; PM Modi visited Poland in 2024, during which ties were elevated to ‘strategic partnership’; Warsaw is also trying to diversify partnerships as trade imbalance and Beijing’s support for Russia deepen disillusionment with China

item.title: Bihar Cabinet approves MOU between WRD & NIH, Roorkee for ‘Flood Plain Zone Delineation Study’
item.description: Cabinet approves 115 acres of land for a sugar mill and 151.58 acres for other industries. ₹12 crore approved for “Bihar State Games 2026”. Nod for underground road corridor in Patna.

item.title: Forest panel rejects Uttarakhand HC relocation plan again over forest land concerns
item.description: The committee directed the State government to explore the possibility of locating the proposed project on suitable non-forest land before pursuing forest clearance

item.title: NCP leader challenges Sunetra Pawar’s decision to appoint a new national chief spokesperson
item.description: Brijmohan Shrivastav claimed that the previously raised queries about her appointment as the national president were still unresolved

item.title: Corporation councillor willing to express regret for abusing and body shaming Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay, her counsel tells Madras High Court
item.description: She has sought anticipatory bail in a case booked against her pursuant to a speech at DMK women’s wing meet held in Chennai on October 7, 2026

item.title: Pakistan minister invites Punjab CM Mann
item.description: Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann had said that he wished to accept the invitation from the organisers of the Lahore International Punjabi Conference in Lahore from November 27 to 29 and would want to visit Sikh shrines in Pakistan

item.title: Bihar MLC polls: Upper caste candidates dominate election results
item.description: The Opposition Congress party which had put up its candidates on five seats has failed to win even a single seat in the elections

item.title: Railways to turn off charging points in trains during night
item.description: The Railway Board’s renewed insistence on implementing the measure follows a recent incident in the South Eastern Railway zone. Railway staff reportedly failed to switch off charging points during the prescribed hours, leading to a power bank explosion while a mobile was being charged.

item.title: Bihar MLC polls: NDA close to win 4 out of 8 seats
item.description: All sitting MLCs of the Teachers constituency lost the election, whereas Janata Dal (United) candidate Neeraj Kumar retained his Patna Graduate Constituency

item.title: All 17 escapees from Theni district jail apprehended in less than 40 hours: IGP South Zone
item.description: On the night of their escape, the remand prisoners claimed that one of the inmates suffered epileptic seizures and required assistance. When a jail warder opened the cell, they overpowered him and escaped.

item.title: New Collectors for Karur, Tiruppur and Tenkasi as T.N. government goes for bureaucratic reshuffle
Bihar MLC polls: Jan Suraaj Party opens account, JD(U)'s Neeraj Kumar 'wins' Patna Graduates seat
item.description: In the Patna Graduates constituency, JD(U)'s Neeraj Kumar has defeated the RJD candidate, though official results for the seat are yet to be declared

item.title: Hunker down: On Cyclone Arnab, its landfall
item.description: Proactive governance kept the casualties low after Cyclone Arnab

item.title: CM to release book co-authored by late B. Madhusoodana Kurup
NTK’s ‘Saattai’ Duraimurugan moves Madras High Court seeking anticipatory bail
item.description: An FIR had been registered against him for his alleged derogatory YouTube video against Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay and Minister Aadhav Arjuna

item.title: Protruding posts, ad boards choke Kochi junctions, endanger commuters
item.description: Bus shelters and bunk shops occupying footpaths force pedestrians to walk along the road; the Corporation has promised follow-up action on complaints, while a ₹1.50-crore project aims to decongest Vyttila Junction

item.title: SAD-AAP trade barbs on drug menace issue in Punjab
item.description: SAD leader Bikram Singh Majithia accused Arvind Kejriwal of misleading Punjabis by giving the disproportionate assets case the label of a drug case to suppress the issue

item.title: Kochi residents flag worsening air quality, especially at night
item.description: MLA seeks Chief Minister’s intervention, citing health risks from air pollution. Pollution control board unable to gather real-time AQI data as Vyttila, Kaloor stations remain non-functional

item.title: Several road surveillance cameras in Kozhikode city on the blink
item.description: Funds crunch delays replacement of defunct cameras, hampering police efforts to gather digital evidence; several highway cameras remain defunct following six-laning works

item.title: KSU leader serves legal notice on private firm MD in Kannur
item.description: The dispute comes amid a wider controversy surrounding the firm and allegations of irregularities in contracts awarded during the tenure of former Kannur district panchayat president

item.title: Farmer injured by gun trap allegedly set for wild boars in Kasaragod
item.description: The gun trap is suspected to have been planted by an unidentified poaching gang that trespassed on farmer’s property to hunt wild boars

item.title: 20 units of illegally mined sand near Ambur seized
item.description: Officials said that the revenue earned in the public auction will go to the State exchequer

item.title: TN Teachers Education University gets new Registrar-in-charge following allegation of irregularities by civilian group
item.description: Welcoming the move, M. Radhakrishnan of Arappor Iyakkam, in a statement, demanded a thorough and transparent investigation into the complaint and legal action against those involved in the “fraud”

item.title: TNCC president asks Karnataka government to respect Cauvery Water Management Authority order
T.N. govt. declares holiday on November 9 in view of Deepavali
Furniture thrown, proceedings disrupted as lawyers’ protest against HC judge turns chaotic
item.description: The conduct of the lawyers prompted the court to consider disciplinary and contempt proceedings against those involved

item.title: Stalin urges Murmu to initiate action against Gyanesh Kumar
Drug peddler held near Katpadi railway station
item.description: A case was registered and he was lodged at Central Prison in Vellore

item.title: Vijay inaugurates advanced electrical labs in 30 government ITIs
item.description: The Chief Minister also distributed cheques of ₹25,000 each to 15 students who won the 59th State-level Skill Competition

item.title: IIT-M provides safe drinking water, waste management facilities to Vallipuram village
item.description: The AquaMAP Centre for Water Management and Policy at IIT-M drafted a project to install three decentralized water treatment plants and established a sustainable solid waste management programme

item.title: Experts in stroke medicine emphasise on timely treatment
item.description: The doctors discussed lifestyle-related risks, including poor dietary habits, physical inactivity, and inadequate sleep

item.title: From garbage dump to green lung: Residents give Aane Park in Malleswaram a new lease of life
Cyclone Arnab: 17 Odisha districts affected by heavy rain, Gajapati worst hit
item.description: As many as 2,245 pregnant women were shifted to nearby health centres, while 931 babies were born during the disaster

item.title: Three schoolgirls from Tiruvannamalai rescued at Kilambakkam bus terminus
item.description: The girls were handed over to the Child Welfare Committee (CWC) for counselling before reuniting with the family members

item.title: Rise in child marriage complaints in Mysuru district
MIDS professor alleges police harassment over fake Instagram account
item.description: In a complaint to the DGP, Prof. Kalaiyarasan said the police told him he was required for an inquiry at T4 Sankar Nagar police station in Pammal over an allegedly abusive comment targeting Pallavaram TVK MLA J. Kamatchi.

item.title: Child rescued in Ranipet; four persons held
item.description: Arrested persons told the police that they had kidnapped the baby past midnight on September 23

item.title: Tiger Shroff firing case: 11 accused re-arrested under MCOCA after court grants permission
item.description: The accused were produced before the special MCOCA court on October 28, a day after the Mumbai Crime Branch invoked provisions of the Act against them

item.title: Kavitha threatens to block census operations over OBC column demand
item.description: Hyderabad Declaration adopts nine resolutions on caste census, reservations

item.title: Maritime Board (Amendment) Bill passed in Assembly amid Opposition walkout
item.description: The Bill provides for reconstitution of the board to establish a centralised decision-making mechanism

item.title: Mob assaults buffalo traders in Madhya Pradesh’s Damoh; two cases lodged
item.description: Damoh Superintendent of Police (SP) Anand Kaladagi told The Hindu that the incident took place on suspicion of buffalo theft

item.title: MLC polls: In Maharashtra, ruling Mahayuti gets 2 seats, counting continues for other seats
item.description: In Maha Vikas Aghadi, NCP SP leads on two seats; setback for ruling NCP prompts senior leader Praful Patel to call for introspection

item.title: Integrated village development programme inaugurated in Nanjangud
UNESCO expert committee seeks stronger community participation in Hampi conservation
Manufacturers told to focus on value addition, design-led innovation, tech ownership
item.description: Speakers at the inaugural session of a CII conference on advanced manufacturing said this underscoring the need for India to move beyond manufacturing scale

item.title: Former MLC moves HC questioning ‘prohibitory list’ of lands, says government targeting BRS leaders
Intensify inspection to stop child labour: ADC
Maha MLC polls: Praful Patel calls for introspection within NCP
item.description: In a post on X, he said the results were a clear and significant warning for the party and stressed the need for introspection to regain people's trust

item.title: BJP MP seeks reopening of Kartarpur corridor, Amit Shah inaugurates exhibition to mark 25 years of Modi’s public service
item.description: Rajya Sabha member Vikramjit Singh Sahney says Prime Minister Narendra Modi deserves the Bharat Ratna for his dedication and service to nation

item.title: M.P. hooch deaths: prime accused used AI to help brew liquor at home, say police
item.description: A total of 11 people have been arrested so far, amid allegations surfacing of over 10 deaths due to spurious liquor in a month in two villages of Dewas district in Madhya Pradesh

item.title: Delhi High Court issues notice on plea against blocking ‘Bring Back Ballot’ Instagram account
item.description: The petition alleged that withholding the entire account with over 50,000 followers was disproportionate, unreasoned and without any notice

item.title: Ashok accuses State Election Commission of printing 90 lakh voter cards after announcement of SIR; SEC denies charge
item.description: Leader of Opposition in the Assembly R. Ashok has accused the State Election Commission of violating norms to facilitate irregularities in the proposed GBA polls by printing 90 lakh voters’ identity cards in Bengaluru at a cost of ₹20 crore after the announcement of Special Intensive Revision by the Election Commission of India
